visual_review.subject: An academic graduation cap inside a rounded rectangular enclosure.
visual_review.keyshape_reason: SQUARE gives the enclosed cap the broadest balanced working space.
references: Supplied reference: retained rounded enclosure, diamond mortarboard and lower cap band.
Lucide graduation-cap original and atomic-debug: geometric diamond and connected lower band.
visual_review.review: Both themes and sizes inspected. Enclosure and mortarboard are recognizable; lower cap band is compressed at native size. Numeric clearance between frame and mortarboard is uncertified. Retained for manual review.
visual_review.asymmetry: Centered cap and enclosure are mirrored about x=24.
